purpose: Machine/audit-friendly reconciliation of issue #486 Identity/Account/Character findings against delivered current-main behavior. Evidence references resolve through evidence_catalog; each referenced evidence entry supplies layer, exact path/spec, what it proves and what it does not prove.

reconciled_main.continuity_evidence: compare 83ebc81a94f052bb967313a4d049369ffadcb80f..ad0fec2bb0ce12a236916fa84af5be8f8f382050 is ahead by 2 and changes only historical-work governance/docs/tooling; no Identity, Account, Character, acceptance, matrix or audited test surface changed

account_lifecycle.spec: @portal-account registration, duplicate identity, invalid login and protected account access
account_lifecycle.proves: browser-visible registration, duplicate rejection, authentication failure/success, protected route and logout
account_lifecycle.does_not_prove: database concurrency or production traffic behavior

account_overview.proves: ready, pending, recoverable, conflict and missing provisioning states plus retry-to-ready

account_security.spec: @portal-account account security lifecycle covers sessions, privacy, verified email recovery, recovery keys and termination grace
account_security.proves: session inventory/revocation, privacy, verified email change/recovery, recovery-key lifecycle and termination grace

account_security_strict.spec: @portal-account account security localization covers Polish responsive, validation, authorization and expired-token states
account_security_strict.proves: Polish account-security surface, desktop/tablet/mobile responsive checks, validation, denial and expired-token states

password_change.proves: password change invalidates current/stale sessions; old credential fails and new credential authenticates

password_recovery.proves: mail-backed one-time reset, current-session invalidation, old-password rejection and subsequent authentication

mfa.proves: enrollment, challenge, invalid/replayed TOTP rejection, recovery-code single-use, second session, disable/global sign-out and stale-session denial
mfa.does_not_prove: MFA methods not implemented by the product

character_boundaries.proves: auth boundary, invalid world, creation, quota, conflict-visible result and ownership
character_boundaries.does_not_prove: locking, uniqueness races or ambiguous DB commit correctness

character_profiles.spec: @portal-community complete rankings, privacy-aware profile, owner preferences, deaths, guild search, localization, resilience and responsive lifecycle
character_profiles.proves: public visibility, owner privacy/profile preferences, main-character selection, guild/house relations, localization, resilience and responsive presentation
character_profiles.does_not_prove: future undelivered lifecycle features or database race invariants

responsive.proves: the included critical scenarios execute at 1440x1000, 820x1180 and 390x844 with overflow/touch/operability assertions
responsive.does_not_prove: every arbitrary viewport; per-surface canonical dimension declarations can intentionally be narrower than all projects that execute the spec

portability.does_not_prove: a Cartesian browser multiplication of secret-bearing/destructive/stateful lifecycles

accessibility.proves: real Tab, Shift+Tab, Space and Enter, focus order and :focus-visible on representative Identity, Account, account-security privacy, MFA and admin paths

resilience.proves: browser-visible dependency interruption, restoration and successful recovery

admin_rbac.spec: Flows 7-9 — admin MFA/RBAC, CMS lifecycle and audit evidence
admin_rbac.proves: guest/user/editor/admin boundaries and same already-authenticated editor context fails 403 on its next privileged request after content_editor revocation
admin_rbac.does_not_prove: forced logout because the implemented contract is per-request authorization

character_db.does_not_prove: browser-visible UX or main-character preference races

character_profile_concurrency.proves: two concurrent main-character selections for one identity both commit while exactly one persisted preference remains main
character_profile_concurrency.does_not_prove: browser-visible owner state or production scheduling

character_feature.proves: server-side validation, authorization, ownership and creation rules

admin_roles_feature.proves: role assignment/revocation persistence and audit behavior

stability.proves: zero-retry repeat and soak calibration history
stability.does_not_prove: production go-live; repository/staging evidence is not PRODUCTION_PROVEN

locale_login.proves: login uses identity translation keys and locale switcher

locale_password_missing.proves: password lifecycle copy remains hard-coded English

locale_overview_missing.proves: core overview headings/actions remain hard-coded English

issue_325.proves: account badges/loyalty/status removed from delivered scope

issue_320.proves: world transfer is not a delivered mutation

lower_layer_boundary: Locking, transaction races, uniqueness correctness and ambiguous database commit correctness remain primarily feature/integration/database evidence; Playwright proves only the resulting user-visible system behavior. Main-character single-selection races are proved by the dedicated independent-process MariaDB character-profile concurrency test.
